name: Disable ad & telemetry daemons
description: 1.3.0 re-suppresses slive-provider-daemon and com.samsung.tv.context-aware-service in the one form the measurement permits: vendor opt-out file plus systemctl stop, never a mask. Both units gate on ConditionPathExists=!/opt/usr/share/systemd/system/<id>, and two key-press rounds confirmed that stopping them costs the remote nothing while masking them caused a 2-3 s dead zone. It unmasks 1.1.0's masks on apply (then daemon-reload) so an upgraded boot heals without a reboot. Masks remain only on the Type=simple daemons and their .path/.socket triggers.
author: levkropp
